stem.text: A cell of negligible internal resistance is connected to resistors $\text{R}_1$, $\text{R}_2$ and $\text{R}_3$, as shown. The cell provides power to the circuit and power is dissipated in the resistors.

stem.alt: Circuit diagram with a cell at the top, resistor R1 in the upper branch, resistors R2 and R3 in the lower branches, and junction dots at the left and right.

A.text: power dissipated in $\text{R}_1$ = power dissipated in $\text{R}_2$ + power dissipated in $\text{R}_3$

B.text: power dissipated in $\text{R}_2$ = power dissipated in $\text{R}_3$

C.text: power output of cell = power dissipated in $\text{R}_1$ + power dissipated in $\text{R}_2$ + power dissipated in $\text{R}_3$

D.text: power output of cell = power dissipated in $\text{R}_1$
